title: Mechanisms of human mitochondrial leaderless mRNA translation initiation

comments: Single-molecule fluorescence combined with structural biology provides mechanistic insight into a clinically relevant process, though the functional advantage of pathway heterogeneity remains unclear.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; sequential 28S→39S assembly observed in parallel pathway
